author: Simon's Cat
description:
A cat's predictions for the year ahead! What's on your bingo card for 2026? Get ready to laugh, smile, and feel the warm fuzzies every fortnight with our 'Caturday Film Club'. Tune in every other Sat(Cat)urday at 2pm GMT / 9am EST for your fortnightly dose of Simon's Cat hilarity. Showcasing the best of Simon's Cat, from old classics to films you might not have seen before, helping you ease into the weekend, relaxed and with a smile on your face!
